text:
Emma (Marketing): ok team, new ask — we need a compact ‘benchstory’ hero illustration + webinar frame pack for next Tuesday. Goal: benchmark narrative visual + 30s social gif variant.
Raj (Design): got it. can you confirm dimensions and priority?
Emma (Marketing): priority high. deliverables: 1) hero static (1200x628) 2) webinar frame (1920x1080 with 160px safe area for overlay) 3) gif variants: 1:1 (1080x1080, 3 sizes: 600kb, 250kb), 16:9 (1280x720, max 800kb) 4) slide template update (16:9 figma file)
Lucy (Creative Ops): tagging brand guardrails + legal for quick sweep. also need source figma + export tokens.
DesignBot: checklist added — exports: PNG @2x, SVG for icons, GIF optimized via gifsicle. Accessibility: text contrast >=4.5:1.
Mike (Growth): include two caption options and CTA: "See the numbers" / "Register — seats limited". We’ll A/B headline.
Sofia (Comms): alt text and short microcopy required for webinar registration page + social. I’ll draft once visuals land.
Raj (Design): quick Q on style — do we lean illustrative (hero character) or data-forward (sparkline + pills)? both work but impacts timeline.
Emma (Marketing): data-forward preferred for benchmark credibility, but include a subtle illustrative accent (single character with badge). keep it on-brand.
Raj (Design): noted. will do main mock by EOD Thursday, assets final by Monday. ping if we need a canary.
Lucy (Creative Ops): localization heads up — we'll need copy placeholders for EN/FR/DE. leave extra padding in the layout for longer strings.
Mike (Growth): social pack also needs animated CTA pulse for the 1:1 gif variant. can you make a 3-frame loop?
Raj (Design): yes. 3-frame loop, 12fps. will hand off source and exported gifs.
Emma (Marketing): messaging options: Headline A: "Serving wins: benchmarked cost × latency" Headline B: "Ship LLM features with predictable inference economics" Use A for technical webinar, B for product-focused landing.
Sofia (Comms): for accessibility, please include visible focus state on CTA in the webinar frame. also we need a transcript CTA for live captioning.
Raj (Design): re: colors — can we use brand accent teal for CTAs, but ensure it passes contrast on light and dark slides?
DesignBot: guideline — teal #008E82 at 16px requires #FFFFFF for 4.5:1 on light backgrounds. add fallback darker teal for dark mode.
Lucy (Creative Ops): legal review requested: @legal-team for claims in benchmark graphic. keep any numeric claims tied to source file (bench-run-0416).
Emma (Marketing): labelling: include footnote area (12px) for the benchmark methodology blurb.
Raj (Design): uploading WIP frames to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/benchstory-webinar-pack — comment on frames named "hero-v1", "frame-webinar-v1"
Lucy (Creative Ops): export settings snippet:
```
export: PNG 2x
gif: gifsicle --optimize=3 --colors 128
svg: preserve-stroke
```
Mike (Growth): can we also get a version with the company logo lockup left and another centered for social split tests?
Raj (Design): yes. will provide both.
Emma (Marketing): ETA check — mock Thursday, review Friday, final Monday morning PST. If design hits blockers, escalate here.
Lucy (Creative Ops): assigning to Raj, marking channel as #marketing. will coordinate L10n and legal once assets are uploaded.
Raj (Design): acknowledged. starting sketches now.
Sofia (Comms): thanks — once visuals live I’ll draft three microcopy variants for testing.
Emma (Marketing): perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
